newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: TENNIS-FILIPPINI, DOSEDEL INTO SEMIS IN AMSTERDAM.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-FILIPPINI, DOSEDEL INTO SEMIS IN AMSTERDAM.

text.p: Uruguay's Marcelo Filippini and Czech Slava Dosedel moved smoothly into the semifinals of the $475,000 Amsterdam Open with convincing victories on Thursday.
Filippini was first to book his last-four berth overpowering sixth-seeded Spaniard Javier Sanchez 7-6 (7-5) 6-1.
Sanchez blew a golden chance to take the opening set but was broken while serving at 6-5 up and Filippini snatched the tiebreak 7-5 before cruising through the second set.
The unseeded Dosedel proved to be the villain of the piece beating home favourite John van Lottum 6-4 4-6 6-2 in Thursday's other quarter-final.
The 21-year-old Van Lottum, ranked 233 in the world, reached the third round at Wimbledon this year and is regarded as one of the rising stars of Dutch tennis.
A thigh-strain picked up in the second set left the Dutchman struggling though, and he finished the match with heavy strapping on his left leg.

Top seed Carlos Moya and fellow Spaniard Francisco Clavet, seeded eighth, meet in Friday's continuation of the quarter-finals. Fourth-seed Magnus Norman, of Sweden, plays the unseeded Christian Ruud of Norway.
